name: G’bagede Illu
description: G’bagede is a city known as the City of Golems. It is famous for the high numbers of golems patrolling the streets, which are produced to safeguard the city and care for all its citizens’ daily needs. Most taii’makus here spend their days in contemplation and ethical debates, most adhering to ethical harmonism, while the golems care for their every need. The only people who work in G’bagede are teachers who educate the young and the golem researchers who develop more advanced and unique creations, aiming to have a specific golem to fill each function society needs. The Illu’s high external walls and hexagonal stone structures proudly demonstrate its culture of resilience and righteousness. Furthermore, due to their golem production, it is one of the most dedicated mining Illus, always searching for metals, especially bauronite and rare ores, with numerous golems devoted to this task. G’bagede is home to the Righteous Sun Celestianist Temple of Tamera, which preaches Tamera as a cosmic being who exemplifies virtuous conduct. It is also known to produce most of the taii’maku clerics and paladins. M’Bollo, the Wharfugee Hero, is the current bishop of this temple and a member of the council that runs the Illu. However, shipments of rare ores from Stravian have recently been targeted by pirates in the Central Seas, disrupting the flow of mithral and tameranium necessary for researching golem improvements. The city seeks help from those who can venture into the Seashores and find more. M’Bollo believes there is more behind the situation than just pirates.
